mapper.select: select (select count(*) from km_media where del_flag = '0') as media_total, (select count(*) from km_media where del_flag = '0' and media_type = 'movie') as movie_total, (select count(*) from km_media where del_flag = '0' and media_type = 'tv') as tv_total, (select count(*) from km_media where del_flag = '0' and visible = '0') as visible_total, (select count(*) from km_person) as person_total, (select count(*) from km_member where del_flag = '0') as member_total, (select count(*) from km_collection where del_flag = '0') as collection_total, (select count(*) from km_mdl_source) as mdl_total, (select count(*) from km_media m where m.del_flag = '0' and ( (select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id) > curdate() or m.status in ('Planned', 'In Production', 'Post Production'))) as upcoming_total, (select coalesce(sum(like_count), 0) from km_media where del_flag = '0') as like_total, (select coalesce(sum(wish_count), 0) from km_media where del_flag = '0') as wish_total, (select coalesce(sum(watched_count), 0) from km_media where del_flag = '0') as watch_total

select media_id, media_type, title, poster_path, poster_local_url, release_date, status, vote_average, popularity, visible, create_time from km_media where del_flag = '0' order by media_id desc limit #{limit}

select m.media_id, m.media_type, m.title, m.poster_path, m.poster_local_url, m.release_date, m.status, m.vote_average, m.popularity, m.visible, m.create_time, (select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id) as online_date from km_media m where m.del_flag = '0' and ( (select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id) > curdate() or m.status in ('Planned', 'In Production', 'Post Production')) order by coalesce(online_date, m.release_date) asc, m.media_id desc limit #{limit}
